title: [Fragment] (Herdringen 9820) (Senfl)
desc: Ludwig Senfl, [Fragment] (Herdringen 9820). 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Source: Herdringen 9820. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
